fields.name: OrleansDbPersistenceOptions library contract
fields.contract: OrleansDbPersistenceOptions supplies a database/provider selection key and a grain-type-indexed set of query contracts. A parameterless instance starts with DatabaseKey "Common", no query mappings, and InitStage ApplicationServices. Construction from a database key and query definitions retains the supplied key and creates a new mapping from each definition's GrainType to that definition.
